description: M1 Persistence (tasks.md T1.1-T1.3, FR-31/32/33/42, AC-10). Add a Repository interface and a SQLite implementation storing ALL entities with idempotent upsert by dedup_key. This is the foundation every later feature persists through; no dependencies on other FEATs.
steps: Create vandy_food_radar/store/__init__.py and vandy_food_radar/store/base.py defining a Repository typing.Protocol with: save_event(event, source_records, provenance, conflicts, score_components) -> None (upsert by dedup_key), get_events_for_day(day: date) -> list[Event], find_by_dedup_key(key: str) -> Event | None, append_history(entry: EventHistory) -> None, get_conflicts(event_id: str) -> list[Conflict], get_score_components(event_id: str) -> list[ScoreComponent], and read helpers get_source_records(event_id) and get_history(event_id) for the web layer. Import entities from vandy_food_radar.models.

Create vandy_food_radar/store/sqlite_repository.py implementing SqliteRepository with stdlib sqlite3. Define a schema with tables events (dedup_key UNIQUE), source_records (event_id FK, raw_payload TEXT, parsed_fields JSON TEXT, source_id, source_url, checked_at, source_updated_at, parse_status), field_provenance, conflicts (competing_values as JSON), score_components (factor, raw_value, weight, contribution, note), event_history. Serialize date/time/datetime/enum values deterministically (ISO strings / enum .value). Upsert: within one transaction, insert-or-update the events row keyed on dedup_key and REPLACE its child rows so re-runs never duplicate events, provenance, conflicts, score components, or history. Accept a db path or ':memory:'.

Create tests/test_store.py following the style of tests/test_models.py: (1) round-trip an Event with source records, provenance, conflicts, score components and read them back equal; (2) upsert idempotency: save the same dedup_key twice and assert exactly one events row and no duplicated child rows; (3) append_history across two saves with a changed field and assert both history rows present without duplication. Use ':memory:' or a tmp_path sqlite file.
acceptance_criteria: Repository protocol exposes save/upsert, get_events_for_day, find_by_dedup_key, append_history, get_conflicts, get_score_components (T1.1, FR-33).
SqliteRepository persists Event, SourceRecord (with raw payload + per-source checked_at + parsed_fields), FieldProvenance, Conflict, ScoreComponent, EventHistory (T1.2, FR-31/32).
Saving the same dedup_key twice yields exactly one event row and no duplicate history/child rows (T1.3, FR-42, AC-10).
uv run pytest tests/test_store.py passes and `make check` is green.
findings:
Implemented in vandy_food_radar/store/ (base.py Protocol, sqlite_repository.py, __init__.py re-exports Repository + SqliteRepository). Import: `from vandy_food_radar.store import Repository, SqliteRepository`.

Repository protocol method signatures (later features must persist through these; all take/return vandy_food_radar.models entities):
- save_event(event: Event, source_records: list[SourceRecord], provenance: list[FieldProvenance], conflicts: list[Conflict], score_components: list[ScoreComponent]) -> None  # UPSERT by event.dedup_key; replaces all child rows in one transaction
- get_events_for_day(day: date) -> list[Event]  # ordered by score_total DESC NULLS LAST, then title ASC
- find_by_dedup_key(key: str) -> Event | None
- append_history(entry: EventHistory) -> None  # append-only, NOT replaced by save_event; caller supplies unique EventHistory.id and event_id
- get_conflicts(event_id: str) -> list[Conflict]
- get_score_components(event_id: str) -> list[ScoreComponent]
- get_source_records(event_id: str) -> list[SourceRecord]  # read helper for web
- get_history(event_id: str) -> list[EventHistory]  # read helper for web, oldest first

DB path handling: SqliteRepository(db_path: str = ':memory:') accepts ':memory:' or an on-disk path; schema auto-created on init (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS), PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON with ON DELETE CASCADE. Also exposes .close(). *.db already gitignored so store.db is a runtime artifact.

Upsert semantics: keyed on events.dedup_key UNIQUE via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(dedup_key) DO UPDATE (does NOT overwrite created_at). The canonical persisted event id is re-read from the row after upsert and used for child rows, so a repeat run with a different event.id but same dedup_key still updates in place. Child rows (source_records, field_provenance, conflicts, score_components) are DELETEd + reinserted every save -> no duplicates (FR-42/AC-10). event_history is the exception: never touched by save_event; grows only via append_history so callers must dedupe/guard history ids themselves.

Serialization (deterministic, for any later reader): date/time/datetime -> ISO strings; enums -> .value; bool -> 0/1 INTEGER (None preserved as NULL / unknown tri-state); SourceRecord.parsed_fields, Conflict.competing_values, FieldProvenance.chosen_value, EventHistory.old/new_value -> json.dumps(sort_keys=True). GeoPoint stored as location_lat/location_lng columns. Round-trip reconstructs entities equal to originals (dataclass __eq__).
